server.name: ymi-roofing-mcp
server.description: MCP tools for YMI Roofing n8n workflows

tools.name: lookup_lead
tools.description: Look up a lead by phone number in the Google Sheets Leads tab. Returns name, suburb, service, score, urgency, and timestamp.

phone.description: Phone number in any format (e.g. 0412345678 or +61412345678)

tools.name: update_job_status
tools.description: Update the status of a job in the Google Sheets Jobs tab.

job_id.description: Job ID from the Jobs sheet

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Send an SMS via Twilio. Wraps an n8n sub-workflow to handle Twilio credentials securely.

to.description: Recipient phone in E.164 format, e.g. +61412345678

tools.name: qualify_lead
tools.description: Call Gemini Flash lead-qualifier with lead data and return score JSON. Returns: {score, urgency, summary, suggested_reply}.

tools.name: generate_review_sms
tools.description: Generate a personalised Google review request SMS via Gemini Flash for a completed job.
